description: This Java class defines a response object for a 'ModifyPolicyEntry' command within a policy management system. It provides static factory methods for creating instances representing different response states (created, modified), parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON. It encapsulates information such as Policy ID, optional policy entry details, labels, and HTTP status, and implements relevant interfaces for policy response handling.
